description:
handle_submit/3 in interactive.ex sends all input to OctoPi.Agent.prompt/2 via expand_prompt_fn (which only expands custom prompt templates, not built-in commands). There is no dispatch for /help, /clear, /compact, /cost, /model, /theme, /config.

Upstream pi intercepts these before sending to the LLM and performs local actions (clear transcript, show cost summary, open model picker, etc.).

Needs: prefix check in handle_submit for '/' inputs — match against builtin_commands() and route to local handlers before falling through to prompt expansion / AI.
title: Built-in slash commands not handled — /help /clear /model etc. sent to AI
